items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: Implementors should be marked as final if concrete subclasses are not supposed to override this template method themselves.
items.translation: 实现者应在不打算让具体子类覆盖此模板方法时标记为final。

items.source:
Extended by Spring's specific DAO support classes, such as:
JdbcDaoSupport, JdoDaoSupport, etc.
items.translation: 由 Spring 特定的 DAO 支持类扩展，例如：JdbcDaoSupport、JdoDaoSupport 等。

items.source:
Concrete subclasses can override this for custom initialization behavior.
Gets called after population of this instance's bean properties.
items.translation: 具体子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义初始化行为。在填充此实例的 Bean 属性后调用。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - in case of illegal configuration
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 在配置非法的情况下

items.source: Exception - if DAO initialization fails (will be rethrown as a BeanInitializationException)
items.translation: Exception - 如果 DAO 初始化失败（将作为 BeanInitializationException 重新抛出）

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: as of 7.0, in favor of direct injection of client dependencies
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，采用直接注入客户端依赖的方式。

items.source: Abstract subclasses must override this to check their configuration.
items.translation: 抽象子类必须重写此方法以检查其配置。

items.source: Concrete subclasses can override this for custom initialization behavior.
items.translation: 具体子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义初始化行为。
